text.en:
The following parcels of land of the public domain in the Municipality of Batac Province of
Ilocos Norte are hereby granted, ceded or transferred in full ownership to the Mariano Marcos Memorial
College of Science and Technology, subject to existing private rights if any, particularly described as follows:

All revenues from the lands set aside under the preceding section shall accrue to and be for the
benefit of the Mariano Marcos Memorial College of Science and Technology: Provided, That the utilization of
any existing timber therein shall be subject to forest laws, rules and regulations.

All laws, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
